Green Tomato Salad
By: gypsy696
Published: Monday, January 3, 2011 - 8:11am

Ingredients




1 large green tomato
1 tablespoon of olive oil
1 teaspoon of sumac powder
A handful of sage and mint leaves, finely chopped

Preparation

1 Slice the tomato into thin round discs. 2 Roll the mint and sage leaves into a tight ball and then chop it up finely. 3 Add to the olive oil and sumac to make a dressing. 4 Drizzle over the tomato slices
